requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for black and 6,000-page yield for CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting over 8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement, enhance customer convenience, and lower total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, ink compatibility, printer hardware support
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be able to reliably deliver 6,000 pages (black/CMY), and CMY bottles must have capacity for >8,000 pages as validated in lab testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new bottles and filling process achieve spill-free reliability during user operation and service.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation is essential for user satisfaction and reducing warranty/service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, NOA-F design, filling mechanism
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User testing must show <1% spill incidents across 1000 uses; no spills in standard service scenarios.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining compatibility with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improved NOA-F design enhances reliability and supports new bottle technology while leveraging existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, compatibility with push-push and TDF
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must pass reliability and compatibility testing with new and legacy mechanisms; functional in 100% of test cases.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie ink formulations with no reformulation required.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, leverages proven technology.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and ink compatibility with new system
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No changes required to ink formulation or PHA; validated in integration tests with new bottles and NOA-F.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modelling
requirements.Description: Conduct reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system meets performance and reliability standards over product life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Completion of reliability and characterization reports; all metrics meet internal thresholds.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Critical for maintaining consistent print quality and minimizing maintenance issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling completed and reviewed; no adverse impact on PQ identified or mitigated.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts to support warranty claims and in-warranty repairs.
requirements.Rationale: Supports maintenance, reduces downtime, and enhances customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts available in service inventory; service documentation updated.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature on the lid of the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Supports advanced features or security as required by new product line.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature functional and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and New Inks
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F and add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing capability for new product configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Line modifications completed and validated in pilot runs.

requirements.Title: Mold for 1 to 4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Develop molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps required for the new bottle system.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed caps are necessary for spill-free operation and correct bottle insertion.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds produced and validated with new bottles in production tests.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system so that PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F can be replaced by customers.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces service costs, and enhances user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customer instructions provided; >90% success in user replaceability testing.

requirements.Title: Support New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure printer system supports a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with business goals to offer extended reliability and lower TCO.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes accelerated life testing to 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product to ensure safe transport and compliance.
requirements.Rationale: Protects product during shipping and meets regulatory/environmental standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests; meets EPEAT3 and LOT4 requirements.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product complies with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Mandatory for market access and environmental leadership.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified under EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures physical compatibility and optimal printer footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays operate without interference; printer passes all fit and function tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and supports advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display functional and meets HP UI guidelines; passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, reduces risk of ink flow issues, and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes ink flow and reliability tests; tubes meet durability targets.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management Changes
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and ensures system reliability with new tank.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions within HP standards; validated with new tank in place.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality and mechanical reliability with new system configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling completed; system passes print quality and durability tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify paper path components to support increased page life up to 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical durability and reliability for extended warranty.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes durability testing to 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part to be replaced at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports extended product life and reduces total cost of ownership for users.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink maintenance part design, service documentation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Part replacement procedure documented; >90% success in service center trials.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (fluidic interconnect) connection for the ink delivery system, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and supports new bottle and tank sizes.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, LEBI ink-tank, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections pass reliability and leak testing; system supports new sizes and keying.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management for the IDS to support new tank and bottle configuration.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system reliability and print quality from first use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup process completes successfully in >99% of first-use scenarios.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm to support new consumables and system configuration.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures maintainability and reduces service events.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm functional; service events reduced by >10% compared to previous model.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with new page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product performance meets customer expectations and business targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ meets or exceeds defined targets in >95% of test cases.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi Module, Dune FW
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi module, and Dune firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time, leverages proven hardware and software.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components pass integration and system tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets evolving security standards and protects HP IP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes internal and external security audits.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Services Support (PaaS, WorkFromHome, Flexworker)
requirements.Description: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service), WorkFromHome/Flexworker, and onboarding/S&O path for Consumer, HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and aligns with strategic business initiatives.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All target business models and onboarding paths supported and documented.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and SMB/Enterprise Manageability
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and Enterprise support including WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets requirements for SMB and Enterprise customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Enterprise Sales, SMB Customers
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solutions functional and validated in target environments.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support (HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD)
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of use for all customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers supported and pass installation tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence (POR and Launch)
requirements.Description: Meet program schedule milestones as indicated (Q3'25 POR, HW checkpoints, bottle/NOA-F checkpoints, build stages, etc.).
requirements.Rationale: Critical for time-to-market and business commitments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints and builds completed on or before scheduled dates.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports reliability and reduces service interventions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing to 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer warranty coverage for 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations for durability and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; system passes required life tests.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput of 25/20 ppm (pages per minute), and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive performance benchmarks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Throughput verified in lab and field testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box for easy serviceability and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service time and cost, improves user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box replaced in <10 minutes in service trials.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Support
requirements.Description: Provide solution features required for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Enables penetration in SMB segment and supports strategic goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB features functional and validated in SMB test cases.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK Variant (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Consider hosting a 12,000-page CMYK variant as a flexible option.
requirements.Rationale: Provides potential for higher yield offering if market demand justifies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Variant defined and business case reviewed if market opportunity arises.

requirements.Title: Trade Page Yield of 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Consider supporting trade page yield of 6,000 pages as a flexible option.
requirements.Rationale: Allows for SKUs tailored to specific market requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trade SKU defined and business case reviewed if needed.
